audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] said Smoke Screen blinds your autos.
audit.why: Riot's text: Smoke Screen creates a cloud that reduces sight range, with magic damage and a brief slow on impact. There is no blind in Graves' kit — a player told his autos are blinded will hold attacks he could have thrown. The real cost to you is vision: you lose the target you wanted to Leap Strike onto.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as sight cut plus slow, which is also why your gap-close fails inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's stage whys were generic and gave no timers on either side.
audit.why: The lane runs on three numbers the page never showed: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and drops further every time his autos land, Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 and 13s at rank 3, and Collateral Damage is 100s at rank 1. Level 6 is his spike, levels 4-5 are yours, and both are cooldown-shaped.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the level-2 through level-6 whys, the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Jax/Jax/Skill/Skill/Jax/Jax while the page's own whys say he chunks you at 2, kites you at 3, you take 4-5, and 6 is "Graves' biggest spike".
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill/Graves/Graves/Jax/Graves/Jax/Jax and the mirror flipped to exactly that. The prose was already right on every stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings moved to match.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: His two-shell burst plus End of the Line chunks you at 2, and Counter Strike is not ranked yet to answer it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Graves must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Still no Counter Strike: he autos, drops Smoke Screen to cut your sight, and Quickdraws off your Leap Strike.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Counter Strike (13s at rank 3) eats both shells, then recast to stun him mid-reload and Empower-Leap in.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Collateral Damage (100s at rank 1) plus End of the Line on stacked True Grit armour bursts you through a mistimed E — his level.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, and his autos keep cutting it down. Engage once it is spent. - Your Counter Strike: 17s at rank 1, and it must eat both shells. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E-counter his KA, Q-W burst.
edits.after: Track Quickdraw (16s): his dash and his True Grit armour. Once it is spent — E both shells, recast the stun, Q in with W.

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen to blind your autos and cut vision so your Leap Strike has nothing to gap-close onto
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to cut your sight and slow you, so your Leap Strike has nothing left to gap-close onto

notes: Smoke Screen was written as a blind; Riot's text is a sight-range cut plus a brief slow on impact — removed. Chart flipped to the packet and the mirror; the content prose already described those stages correctly, only the side tokens disagreed. The packet's suspectNames on "Hold Counter Strike" and "Relentless Assault's" are false positives — both names are real. Note the same Jax-R naming split flagged on jax__garen: this page says "Grandmaster at Arms" in content and "Grandmaster's Might" in full; left untouched pending one ruling.
